_readme: Machine-readable keys for the opt-in figure review job (FIG, persona F01; hx.py new --figures). figure_rubric.md defines the criterion anchors, the role expectations and the defect definitions; figure_review_rules.md says how the figure reader works. validate.py requires: figure_scores[id].role in roles; figure_scores[id].criteria with exactly these criteria, each an integer 1-5 (null only for the nullable ones, i.e. when the figure shows no comparison); every FIG weakness has figure_id (an id from snapshot/figures/figures.json or "global") and defect from defects. Frozen per session in review_config.figure_criteria.
